So, if you’re looking for great travel games to play outside or perhaps some fun learning games for kids, or even games for couples—whether you find yourself in the heart of your own local city, visiting a major travel destination or it could be that you’re somewhere under a rock; you’ll find fun travel games for everyone everywhere all on our free app!
 
What are Questo travel games like?

Questo’s outdoor travel games contain a mashup of cherry-picked elements from escape rooms, scavenger hunts and fun learning games for couples, families, solo adventurers, you name it! 

All of Questo’s outdoor games are unique and have their own theme to suit any taste. These can be inspired by a movie, a book, a historical fact, or even a local legend. In London, for instance, you can become Sherlock and crack an ‘unsolvable’ case, while in Zurich you can partner up with Einstein himself! Team up and play with friends to make things even more interesting!
 
How do Questo travel games work?

After selecting any of our fun outdoor games or any of our fun learning games for kids in the app and downloading it, you’ll head to the starting point shown and proceed to follow a thematic route using in-app directions. 

Throughout any of our travel games, you will have all sorts of opportunities to engage with your surroundings, from the game’s gripping fictional narrative to brainteasing challenges—all in the palm of your hand. It’s as simple as A, B, C:

A: Play outside alone, as a couple, or play with friends by following directions and searching your surroundings to discover each exciting checkpoint, fully immersed in a fictional narrative penned by our top-notch writers.

B: Solve puzzling challenges to unlock some fun factoids behind each checkpoint. That’s why Questo games make for fun learning games!

C: Get your name on the global leader board and competitively play with friends like never before in the real world!
 
Why play a Questo travel game?

+ Budget-friendly:
Our outdoor travel games are much cheaper than hiring a guide or booking another experience. We also offer some free games, such as those made in partnership with big brands and new games in test mode! 

+ Flexible:
Start, pause or replay at any time. Explore our outdoor games at your own pace, without depending on the schedule of anyone else.

+ Private: 
All our travel games/outdoor games are completely self-guided. They can be played alone or in a private group.

+ Play offline:
Download our travel games ahead of time and play outside without any cellular data, no need to worry about expensive roaming charges when travelling abroad!

+ Fun: 
Play outside and immerse yourself in a fictional narrative—following clues and solving puzzles while discovering new spots and lesser-known stories!

+ Available worldwide:
Questo travel games are available across the globe:
+ North America, South America, UK & Europe, Asia, Oceania

Questo travel games are perfect for:

+ groups looking to play with friends
+ lone travelers searching for outdoor games
+ couples looking for new and exciting games for couples
+ families eager to find fun learning games for kids
 
All Questo’s outdoor travel games are built by a creator using our platform and tools. If you want to build your own Questo game and earn passive income, we recommend that you play a game first.

If you booked any of our travel games through an online booking agency, then just download this app, create your account, and your game should be visible from your Profile.
If you need any help or support, feel free to use our in-app chat.
